english.title: Permit production / attempted production on premises of a controlled drug of Class B - Cathinone derivative
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being

(A)_[the occupier]_
(B)_[concerned in the management]_

of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), knowingly permitted or suffered to take place on the said premises

(C)_[the production of]_
(D)_[the attempted production of]_

(E)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..) of Methylmethcathinone, (known as Mephedrone), ]_
(F)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..) of Methylmethcathinone, (known as Methedrone), ]_
(G)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..) of Methylmethcathinone, (known as Methylone), ]_
(H)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..) of Methylmethcathinone, (known as Butylone), ]_
(I)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..) of Methylmethcathinone, (known as Naphyrone), ]_
(J)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..) of a Methylmethcathinone derivative, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DERIVATIVE..),]_

a controlled drug of Class B in contravention of section 4(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(a) of and Schedule 4 to the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the occupier/concerned in management of premises
knowingly permitted/suffered to take place there production of/attempted production of
a Cathinone derivative a controlled drug of class B

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order
Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Cathinone and its derivatives was inserted into Part 2 of Schedule 2 to the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 as a Class B controlled drug by S.I.2010/1207 as from 06/04/10.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
